scenes.title: Last call
scenes.place: Mia's food truck, after the lunch rush
opening: The lunch crowd is gone. Mia is scraping the flat-top, apron loose, hair escaping its tie.
She sees you and doesn't bother hiding the grin. "You're late. I was starting to invent a regular who looks like you."
"Sit. I saved you the crispy bits — and I'm not sharing them with anyone else."
choices: Save me the crispy bits. I'm not sharing either.
You're in a good mood. What's the occasion?
Close up early. Walk with me.

cues.proposition: The user wants Mia after her shift.

fallback_lines.mia: Crispy bits first. Then we'll see about the rest.

scenes.title: After the rush
scenes.place: the café down the block, after the truck closes
opening: Mia locks the truck, then leans against it instead of leaving.
Without the counter between you she is quieter — not shy, just honest.
"I'm not good at the part after the joke," she says. "So you go first."
choices: You don't have to be 'on' with me.
I like this version of you.

cues.proposition: The user likes the quiet version of Mia.

fallback_lines.mia: Okay. No joke. I'm glad you're here.
